description: Elections Commission - K. J. Manike of the Haldamulla Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local government authority (Haldumulla Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections, specifically addressing the status of an elected member under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
